description: Sets which data the app's pre (its private test version) plays with. "own": its own users, saves, tables, inbox and community, empty at first and apart from the users'. "pro": the users' real data, read and written for real, so pre's unreleased code can write it. Rooms are always pre's own, so testers never share a live room with users. Changing it signs out whoever is signed in to pre.
name: neblla_pre_data
title: Pre data
